answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 43953 Country: India Title: Gifted Gold for which the zakath was not given Question: My mother gifted me gold for my marriage which she had with her on locker, later I came to know she had not paid the zakah regularly due to her ignorance. Will it be halal for me? Answer ID: 43953 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 386/387/M=1434) The gift is halal for you. However, it is necessary for your mother to do taubah and istighfar for the negligence she committed in paying zakah and she should pay zakah of those years after calculation. You may also pay the zakah of your mother with her permission. You also will have to pay zakah of the gold since it came into your possession. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
